candidates.title: Kettlebell High Pull
candidates.description:
For the kettlebell high push, line the kettlebell directly in between the feet.

Push the hips back - deadlift start position

Grip the kettlebell with both hands, lead with the elbows - one motion comes to the chest - keeping elbows above the weight

Back to the waist, going into deadlift position to the floor

candidates.title: How to Perform the Kettlebell High Pull | Full Movement Breakdown
candidates.description:
Discover the Ultimate Guide to the Kettlebell Snatch along with 4 workouts here: https://kettlebellsworkouts.com/teaching-points-for-the-kettlebell-snatch/

The kettlebell high pull is a highly cardiovascular kettlebell exercise that works into the back of the body along with many of the muscles used in the swing.

It is vital to master the kettlebell high pull exercise before attempting the kettlebell snatch as it prepares you for the top position of the movement along with giving you the confidence with taking the kettlebell overhead.
